checks: Corresponding canonical context resolved for all entries. Hangul/jamo,digits,blanks/placeholders preserved. Romanized learning targets retained while meaning glosses/instructions localized; pure Korean/phonetic choices preserved.
KcoursePolicy: K1..10 are course steps, not official proficiency grades.
entityPolicy: No new Korean persons/settings authored. Existing named people remain unknown absent explicit source evidence. No gender inferred from English reference pronouns or names. Omitted Korean agents left unspecified where reporting constructions require it.

sourceIssues.reason: English fragment friend said coming risks making friend the reporting speaker; Korean says friend is coming, with reporting speaker omitted. Targets follow Korean referents without inventing speaker.
English well is not expressed by Korean 글씨가 써져요; targets do not add well.
Korean 주목받다 means receiving attention, not necessarily popular; targets preserve attention meaning.
English adds Chuseok context not in target sentence; translated Korean make songpyeon without adding occasion.
Afrikaans gender-neutral sib preserves unspecified sibling; uncommon lexical register needs native review.
